descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B13 · 已排除（票还在 in progress / ready for pr（Quinn 10-14：不计入 bug 数））· 原 P1

已经按保留期清掉的数据会被写回：清理前就开着的旧标签页点 Save Medications / Vitals / Labs，或手机上没发出去的本地副本一打开病历，就把旧数据当成刚记录的重新存回去

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：和 B10 同一类机制：旧客户端状态覆盖服务器，没有版本校验

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S25

思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S27 「两台设备下的 12 h 窗口：清掉的文字在留了副本的手机上也保持清掉，每台设备各自闲置超时」 12 h windows with two devices: cleared text stays cleared on a phone that kept a copy, and each device idles out on its own

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 Retention windows hold with two devices: once the server clears pre-round text (12 h) or encounter text (its window), no copy kept on another device (open chart state or session draft) brings it back …（UAT 3.6）
  • T1 Each device goes through its own email-code sign-in (a new device always asks for a code). The two do not share a session token, and both stay valid at once.（TFA-94513 AC 6；TFA-94513 AC 10；UAT TC-25 step 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given (R) Phone A has {hospitalPatient}'s Pre-Round open and a kept draft for that field (IndexedDB); the computer has the chart closed. (I) Both devices signed in with their own sessions; the computer stays active

When (R) The aging helper ages the pre-round text to 12 h + 1 min and the retention job clears it; then phone A comes back, remounts the chart and stays idle for 60 s. Repeat with the encounter text aged past its 36 h window + 1 min. …

Then (R) The server field stays empty, the computer shows no pre-round (or encounter) text, and phone A's IndexedDB has no row for that field: no copy on a device brings back text the server cleared. (I) At + 1 min the phone lands on the sign-in gate and the computer is still on its list; at - 1 min both are signed in

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：(R) read-only adminQuery: the field is empty after phone A's 60 s idle; the computer's chart (after a reload) mustNotContain 'QA-SYNC-RET-PR' ('QA-SYNC-RET-EN'); phone A's IndexedDB has no row for that field's draft id (UAT 3.6, OAT-04 'never survives past its window'). …

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S27 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94513 in progress；TFA-94745 ready for qa；TFA-94699 in progress

保留期已经删掉的 pre-round 或 encounter 文字，只要有一台手机存着没发出去的副本，一打开病历就写回服务器，两台设备上都会重新出现。

Pre-round or encounter text that the retention job already deleted comes back on both devices when a phone that kept an unsent copy reopens the chart.

依据：allure-results/cacf9f3a…: after the retention sweep cleared the pre-round (12 h + 1 min) and the encounter (36 h + 1 min), a phone with an IndexedDB draft reopened the chart and re-sent it. The server field holds the text again and the computer shows it. useAutosave restores drafts with no age check (the TFA-94745 draft store). The session-idle half passes. A TC-25 matrix risk predicted it; it is not in the dev report, ledger or knownGaps.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S27

12 h windows with two devices: cleared text stays cleared on a phone that kept a copy, and each device idles out on its own

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: yes）：sync-probe: (R) the chart's pre-round (processed) / encounter text seeded with stamps aged 12 h+1 min / 36 h+1 min (the aging helper's effect via client-writable stamps), phone keeps an IndexedDB draft written just after the last save, the retention sweep clears the field, phone remounts and idles 60 s: server field stays empty, computer shows nothing, no draft row left; (I) phone session expiry backdated to −1 min / +1 min: phone on the sign-in gate / still in, computer stays in. [Review 2026-10-14] Added L-leftover legs (record-only premise): leaving the field within 0.8 s leaves a device copy of saved text that nothing deletes. R legs also record the *EditedAt stamps after the sweep and the archived transcript entry. — aging is done through the app's own client-writable stamps + applyLifecycle (as manual/aging.ts does), session idle via the test hook.

Detail:

Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). (R) pre-round (processed, 12 h + 1 min) and encounter (36 h + 1 min), Hospital: the sweep cleared the server field and left *EditedAt where it was (read back: same as seeded); phone A, which kept a device copy (harness-written 1 s after the last save), reopened the chart and idled 60 s: the server field holds the text again, stamped now, the computer shows it, and the phone's draft row is gone (restored and re-sent). Encounter: the sweep's archive entry 'Oct 12 · Encounter notes' holds the same text, so it now exists twice. (L-leftover, record-only premise, both contexts): typing then leaving the chart 0.3 s later (in-app Back) saved the text to the server and left a device copy with the same text; it was still there after reopening the chart and field — the normal-use way the R legs' starting state arises. (I) +1 min: phone on the sign-in gate, computer still on its list; −1 min: both signed in. Side observation (not this oracle): the archive label uses the server's UTC date (lifecycle.ts:88 toLocaleDateString without a time zone): an encounter written 06:06 JST Oct 13 is labelled 'Oct 12'.

产品问题：[kept-draft-restore-after-sweep] Text the retention sweep cleared comes back from a device copy. What a physician sees: yesterday's pre-round text (past its 12 h window) or encounter text (past 36 h) reappears, undated, in today's field on the phone, is saved again (stamped now) and shows on the computer; in Hospital the encounter the sweep had already archived ('Oct 12 · Encounter notes') is re-saved as today's encounter as well. How such a copy is left behind in normal use: a device copy left behind after a normal save — e.g. leaving the field within the 0.8 s autosave (the unmount flush writes the copy and saves; nothing deletes the copy once the server has the same text: TC-25/S27 L-leftover, both contexts), or a Save Note that changes the stored text (TC-25/S17 b-hospital end-of-run row). Cause: the sweep clears preRoundNotes / encounterNotes (convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:124, :163 Hospital; :306, :329 Nursing Home) without moving *EditedAt, and useAutosave restores any device copy whose savedAt is newer than that stamp, however old (src/lib/useAutosave.ts:115-137; the copy's own age is never checked). Breaks UAT 3.6 (retention windows) and OAT-04 ('never survives past its window'); EFS U13 / S28 (c) (old text not silently put into today's field).

证据：附了 8 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs the aging helper (local admin key: ages the field's EditedAt and the phone session's lastActive, then runs the retention job) and sync-probe's two createAuthSession contexts; on dev there is no admin key and the runner may neither age rows nor touch the saved sign-in, so it runs on the loca…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
